name: Medical Guardian
why: One of the largest national medical-alert brands; MyGuardian member portal with online billing and bank autopay.

name: Lively (formerly GreatCall / Jitterbug)
why: Best-known senior phone and medical-alert service (Jitterbug); My Account with online payments, autopay and plan changes.

name: Bay Alarm Medical
why: Major national medical-alert provider; Account Manager app/dashboard handles payments and billing.

name: MobileHelp
why: Large national mobile medical-alert provider with the MyMobileHelp member portal.

name: Lifeline (formerly Philips Lifeline)
why: The original and one of the largest U.S. PERS brands; account-number bill-pay portal.

name: ADT Health / ADT Medical Alert
why: National medical-alert line of ADT, billed through MyADT with EasyPay; distinct ADT Health billing FAQs and phone.

name: LifeFone
why: Long-running national medical-alert brand with a customer portal and online bill pay.

name: MedicAlert Foundation
why: Iconic nonprofit medical ID membership with online My Account renewal and auto-renewing annual plans.

name: LifeStation
why: Established national medical-alert provider with an online invoice payment page.

name: Alert1
why: Well-known national medical-alert provider with a My Account page for card and account updates.

name: Medical Alert (MedicalAlert.com)
why: National Connect America consumer brand with its own Bill Pay Portal (account number, last name, billing ZIP).

name: Guardian Medical Monitoring
why: Regional PERS provider with a full Brightree Patient Portal: sign-in, one-time pay, AutoPAY and eDelivery.

name: GetSafe
why: National wall-button medical alert brand with its own Account Manager portal (sister company of Bay Alarm Medical).

name: Aloe Care Health
why: Well-known smart-hub medical alert with an online account and recurring card or bank billing.

name: Galaxy Medical Alert Systems
why: Canadian medical alert provider with an online My Account and automatic card or bank billing.

name: Medical Care Alert
why: Established national provider; billing is automatic card/ACH handled by phone (online account is a stand-in).

name: UnaliWear (Kanega Watch)
why: Well-known medical alert watch; billing and cancellation by phone/letter (online account is a stand-in).

name: QMedic
why: National private-pay and Medicaid PERS provider; billing by phone (online account is a stand-in).

name: ResponseNow
why: National medical alert provider with published monthly/quarterly/annual pricing; billing by phone (online account is a stand-in).

name: Life Alert
why: Best-known U.S. medical alert brand; pricing, payment and cancellation (under a service agreement) are handled by phone (online account is a stand-in). Replaced Rescue Alert in review.
